```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
source("analysis_A.R", local = TRUE)
source("supplements_A.R", local = TRUE)
shared_path <- resolve_a_shared(params$shared_dir)
a <- run_a(shared_path)
extra <- plot_a_supplements(shared_path, a)
a_has_plotly <- requireNamespace("plotly", quietly = TRUE)
a_chart <- function(path, label) {
  htmltools::tags$button(
    type = "button", class = "a-zoom", title = "Open full-size chart",
    `aria-label` = paste("Enlarge", label),
    htmltools::tags$img(src = unname(path), alt = label)
  )
}
```

A. Spatial distribution
=======================================================================

T01. Where is fishing activity concentrated?
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### T01 · Global distribution

```{r t01-main}
htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::div(class = "a-identity",
    htmltools::strong("Name"), params$student_name,
    htmltools::strong("Student ID"), params$student_id),
  htmltools::div(class = "a-lead",
    "For classmates exploring where AIS-observed fishing activity was concentrated in 2023. Click a static chart to enlarge it."),
  a_chart(a$paths[["T01"]], "Annual fishing hours across global grid cells"))
```

**Read the map.** Position shows where each 0.1° cell is. Log-scaled color makes the wide range of annual hours visible. High values cluster along the East Asian coast. Gray is recorded zero and blank ocean has no record.

### Northwest Pacific close-up

```{r t01-closeup}
a_chart(extra$paths[1], "Fishing hours near the East Asian coast and in the Northwest Pacific")
```

**Why zoom in?** The same grid and color scale expose coastal patterns that are harder to see globally. The circled cell at **119.35°E, 35.05°N** is the annual maximum at **316,398.92 hours**, aggregated across vessels.

T02. How do FAO marine areas compare?
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### T02 · Fishing hours by marine area

```{r t02-main}
a_chart(a$paths[["T02"]], "Ranked total fishing hours in FAO marine areas")
```

**Compare totals.** Sorted bars share a zero baseline. The Northwest Pacific (61) leads with **68.29 million hours**, or **61.13%** of the global total. The global denominator includes the unmatched category shown in gray.

### Active footprint and fishing hours

```{r t02-footprint}
if (a_has_plotly) {
  interactive_a_footprint(extra, a)
} else {
  a_chart(extra$paths[2], "Active grid count versus fishing hours for each FAO marine area")
}
```

**Compare coverage with totals.** The scatterplot keeps each region's active cell count and total hours visible together. The Northwest Pacific had **127,686** active cells, fewer than the Western Indian Ocean's **153,753**, and much higher total hours. Unmatched cells are excluded here. `r if (a_has_plotly) "Hover over a point for the area name, cell count and hours." else ""`

T03. How concentrated are the hours across cells?
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### T03 · Cumulative contribution

```{r t03-main}
if (a_has_plotly) {
  interactive_a_curve(a)
} else {
  a_chart(a$paths[["T03"]], "Cumulative share of fishing hours by ranked active cells")
}
```

**Read the curve.** Sort cells with positive hours from highest to lowest. The steep rise shows concentration. The top **1%, 5%, and 10%** contribute **65.98%, 85.16%, and 90.21%** of all hours. The denominator for cell ranks is **1,193,301** active cells. `r if (a_has_plotly) "Select **Top 10%** to focus on the steepest part of the curve." else ""`

### Contribution of each rank band

```{r t03-bands}
a_chart(extra$paths[3], "Separate fishing-hour contributions of four active-cell rank bands")
```

**Compare distinct groups.** Each bar represents a separate rank band. The remaining **90%** of active cells account for **9.79%** of all hours. Counts round up at the 1%, 5%, and 10% thresholds. Cell counts refer to angular grids whose physical area varies by latitude.

<div class="a-source">Fishing hours are GFW estimates from AIS observations. Coverage varies across places. FAO areas are assigned by grid centre. Sources: <a href="https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14982712">GFW v3.0</a>, <a href="https://www.fao.org/cwp-on-fishery-statistics/handbook/general-concepts/main-water-areas">FAO</a>, and <a href="https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/110m-physical-vectors/110m-land/">Natural Earth</a>.</div>
